svg.title: 01 Warehouse workflow | Warehouse Returns ERD
svg.desc: Warehouse returns database design based on functional requirements version 2.1. Relationship types use 1:1, 1:N, N:1, and N:M notation; optional participation is explained separately.
svg.text: FRD 2.1 | 10 operational tables; 5 supporting tables on tab 02 | Rajdeep Villuri and Hunter Yee | October 24 2026
One or more lines at commit.
FK W = item key + local WorkOrderNumber.
Initial / PostRepair / Final; latest same-item order.
Local number; at most one active order per item.
A product has one primary vendor.
Partial key LineNumber; one physical unit per line.
First day of month; whole nonnegative units.
Physical area or exit; no free-text locations.
Zero or one lifetime claim; one settlement.
Inspection to WorkOrder is optional in the general model.
Initial has no order. PostRepair and repaired-item Final must
reference the same item's latest completed order, at/after completion.
FK I = composite ReturnItem FK (ReturnID, LineNumber).
FK U = User; FK R = ReferenceValue; see tab 02 for each link.
PK = primary key (underlined) FK = foreign key UK = unique key NULL = nullable; other attributes required.
Endpoint 1 / N / M = maximum cardinality. T = total participation (double line); P = partial participation (single line).
1:N and N:1 are opposite readings of one relationship. Optionality is separate from maximum cardinality.
Proposed MySQL types: INT / BIGINT / SMALLINT are UNSIGNED; TS = DATETIME(6); MONEY = DECIMAL(12,2);
Vn = VARCHAR(n); BOOL = TINYINT(1). Composite FKs use all listed columns together. Dates use the warehouse time zone.
